meta.name: claw-background-jobs
meta.description:
Claw background job management using x agent run and x agent job.
Use when the agent needs to offload complex or long-running tasks that would block the chat.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将耗时任务转为后台作业，不阻塞对话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在对话中执行长时间运行的任务而不阻塞聊天
copy.tagline_en: Offload complex tasks to background jobs without blocking chat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run long tasks without blocking the conversation

howto.what: Claude 可以把耗时超过2分钟的任务（如多步骤操作、数据分析、研究）放到后台异步执行，避免阻塞对话。任务完成后，Claude 会主动汇报结果。
howto.when: 当你提出的任务预计耗时超过2分钟，或者会阻塞对话时，Claude 会使用后台任务来执行。

say.text: 帮我分析这份销售数据，后台运行。
say.note: 任务会异步执行，不阻塞对话。

say.text: 后台运行一个多步骤的研究任务。
say.note: Claude 会创建后台任务并继续对话。

howto.what_en: Claude can offload tasks estimated >2 minutes (e.g., multi-step, data analysis, research) to run asynchronously in the background, avoiding chat blocking. After completion, Claude reports results.
howto.when_en: When you request a task that is expected to take more than 2 minutes or would block the chat, Claude will use background jobs.

say_en.text: Analyze this sales data in the background.
say_en.note: Task runs asynchronously without blocking chat.

say_en.text: Run a multi-step research task in the background.
say_en.note: Claude creates a background job and continues the conversation.
